description: Source file implementing wrapper functions for nl80211 API interactions related to Access Point management, including event listener setup, station info retrieval, vendor commands, and frame handling.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_setEvtListener
methods.description: Sets up an event listener for the specified Access Point, handling registration and callback setup.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_delEvtListener
methods.description: Removes the event listener associated with the specified Access Point.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_getInterfaceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves interface information for the specified Access Point.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_delVapInterface
methods.description: Deletes the VAP interface for the specified Access Point, depending on radio association.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_getStationInfo
methods.description: Fetches station information for a given MAC address associated with the Access Point.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_getAllStationsInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information for all stations associated with the Access Point, including WDS interfaces.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_copyStationInfoToAssocDev
methods.description: Copies station info into an associated device structure, updating metrics and status.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_sendVendorSubCmd
methods.description: Sends a vendor-specific command to the nl80211 interface.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_sendVendorSubCmdAttr
methods.description: Sends a vendor-specific command with attributes to the nl80211 interface.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_sendManagementFrameCmd
methods.description: Sends a management frame through nl80211.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_registerFrame
methods.description: Registers a frame pattern for monitoring or handling.
